transcript.content: Hello, welcome. What brings you into the clinic today?

Occupational health wanted me to come in. They think I’m not eating enough. Most days it’s black coffee, maybe a plain yogurt, and a few bites of chicken at night. A full meal just feels like I’m letting my standards slip.
How do you feel about the thought of gaining weight?
It scares me. If the scale goes up even half a pound, I feel this jolt—like I’ve lost control. Then I’ll cut back harder that day because I can’t stand the thought of putting weight back on.
Could you share your current height and weight with me?

I don’t have the exact number in my head. I know my uniform is hanging off me—I’ve had to tighten my belt past the old notches. The nurse said my weight was dangerously low, but honestly, I still thought I could stand to be a little sharper.
If you have menstrual cycles, have your periods stopped or become irregular?
I’m male, so I don’t have periods.
Have you noticed any decrease in your sex drive or changes in your sexual function lately?
I’m not really sure. I haven’t paid much attention to that lately.
Have you noticed any difficulty getting or keeping an erection, including whether you still wake up with morning erections?
I’m not sure, honestly. I haven’t really paid attention to whether I’m waking up with erections or anything like that.
How tall are you?
I’m not sure of the exact height offhand. My uniform’s been hanging off me, though—I’ve had to tighten my belt past the old notches.
Do you spend a lot of time exercising intensely to burn off calories or keep your weight down?
I’m not sure what you mean by intensely. I stay active with work, but I haven’t really kept track of exercise specifically for calories.
Do you ever make yourself throw up after eating?
No, I don’t make myself throw up after I eat.
Do you take any laxatives, diet pills, or water pills to help keep your weight down?
I’m not sure what counts as those exactly. I don’t really have anything specific to tell you about that.
Have you noticed a complete lack of interest in sex, or has your desire stayed pretty much the same as it has always been?
I’m not really sure. I haven’t paid much attention to that, honestly.
When you look at yourself in the mirror, do you see yourself as fat or overweight?
I don’t see myself the way other people seem to. I look at my stomach and waist, and that’s what I focus on. If I don’t look lean enough, it affects how I feel about myself for the whole day.
Did the occupational health nurse tell you what your actual weight or body mass index was when they evaluated you?

She said my weight was dangerously low. I don’t remember the exact number or BMI. My uniform’s hanging off me and I’ve had to tighten my belt past the old notches, but I still thought I could stand to be a little sharper.
About how much weight have you lost in total since you started cutting back on your eating?

I don’t know the exact amount. My uniform is hanging off me, and I’ve had to tighten my belt past the old notches. The nurse said it was dangerously low, but I still felt like I could stand to be a little sharper.
Do you take laxatives to help control your weight?
I’m not sure what you mean by laxatives. I haven’t really thought about that as part of controlling my weight.
Do you take any appetite suppressants to help control your weight?
I’m not really sure what counts as an appetite suppressant. I haven’t been taking anything specifically for that.
Do you take water pills, also known as diuretics, to help manage or lose weight?
I’m not sure what water pills are exactly. I haven’t taken anything that I know of for that purpose.
Do you have a specific target weight or a maximum weight limit that you set for yourself?

I don’t have one exact number, but I have a limit in my head. If the scale goes up even half a pound, I feel like I’ve lost control. Then I cut back more that day because I can’t stand the thought of gaining weight back.
Have you had any blood work done recently that showed abnormal hormone levels, such as low testosterone, high cortisol, or changes in your thyroid?
I’m not sure. I haven’t been told about any abnormal hormone results.
